calibration: Background bank has no positive subjects and is disjoint from evaluation query text; no parameter tuning on evaluation queries.
limitations: Synthetic flat illustrations only; no user assets, photos, document screenshots or video.
No official reference implementation, other quantizations, Windows or packaged app tested.
Calibration results are diagnostic candidates, not a validated production fix.

thresholds.note: Predeclared diagnostic thresholds, not release quality gates.

queries.subject: house
queries.text: a house with a red roof

textFocus.method: For each length, rank 40 images and 32 correctly prefixed documents. Alternate prefixes are isolated score diagnostics and never added to main rankings. Binary content relevance includes registration text visible in unrelated-en/zh image footers for registration queries; no preference for image or text.
limitations: Short synthetic documents; no file decoding or truncation-boundary inference test.
Repeated and padded texts differ in character and token lengths across languages; this is not an equal-token language ablation.
Abstract query topics other than registration intentionally have no positive image candidates.
Registration has 18 positive candidates; maximum Recall@10 is 10/18 for those two queries.
